mission_10: Congratulations on completing the Data Normalization chapter! You have built a sophisticated normalization pipeline that applies different scaling strategies based on column characteristics. You learned to profile data for skewness and outliers, select appropriate transformations (PowerTransformer for skewed data, RobustScaler for outlier-prone data, StandardScaler for normal data, MinMaxScaler for bounded data), and combine them into a unified pipeline. This adaptive approach to normalization is what separates production-quality ML systems from basic tutorials. You are now equipped to handle any normalization challenge in your data science projects!
